# Frame UI

> A no-build CSS + JS UI kit for client apps (dashboards, tables, forms, auth, billing, settings). Accessible, responsive, fast. 40 themes (each with light and dark), 320+ icons, 17 page templates. Built to be used by AI agents: no Python, Node or npm required.

If you are an AI agent asked to build UI with Frame, read ONE of these and start:
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything in a single document (rules, components with markup, behaviours, themes, icons, pages, starter). Best when you can only fetch URLs.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules and workflow, if you have the folder.

Link the kit from the same base URL as this file (replace BASE):
```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="BASE/frame.css" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="BASE/themes/pine.css" crossorigin>
<script src="BASE/frame.js" data-sprite="BASE/icons.svg" defer></script>
```

Parts:
- [components.json](components.json): every component: classes, modifiers, example markup, daisyUI equivalent.
- [starter.html](starter.html): minimal working app shell. Page templates: `pages/NAME.html` (dashboard, orders, detail, pipeline, inbox, reports, tables, form, calendar, notifications, settings, profile, billing, onboarding, errors, ui, auth).
- [themes.json](themes.json): 40 themes; link `themes/NAME.css` (one file, light + dark).
- [icons.json](icons.json): icon names, tags and categories.
- [frame.js](frame.js): behaviour via data-attributes (documented in its header). Add `data-check` to its script tag to validate a page in the browser.
- [preview.html](preview.html): the whole kit rendered, for humans.
